# The HTML Standard's named character references, vendored as the source of
# LeanTex/Core/HtmlEntityData.lean (scripts/gen-html-entity-data.lean).
#
# source:   https://html.spec.whatwg.org/entities.json, the JSON form of the
#           HTML Living Standard's table of named character references
#           (§13.5), byte for byte; served with last-modified
#           Wed, 12 Nov 2025 00:20:03 GMT and etag "6913d2b3-239e9"
# fetched:  2026-10-19, from that URL
# license:  Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, and BSD
#           3-Clause where incorporated into source code — the generated
#           module is such a portion; LICENSE beside this file is the
#           upstream file verbatim (https://github.com/whatwg/html, LICENSE).
#           Copyright © WHATWG (Apple, Google, Mozilla, Microsoft).
# checked:  SHA256SUMS lists the sha256 of each file's upstream bytes;
#           `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` run from this directory verifies them
#
# Taken: entities.json (2231 names, each with its code points and characters)
# and LICENSE. The generator keeps the 2125 names ending in `;`, the only
# ones CommonMark reads (§2.5, "Entity and numeric character references");
# the 106 legacy names without it are HTML's parse-error recovery.
